diagnosis: Reward/value areas (OFC/vmPFC) are low: no 'I want this' signal
Face areas (FFA/STS) are silent: no human or gaze cue
Attention drops after the first 2 s (+0.88 → +0.72): nothing to look at after the first impression
directives: Make the benefit concrete and desirable: show the outcome (before/after, real numbers, price or scarcity), warm highlight color on the offer, social proof near the CTA.
Introduce a human cue: a portrait or illustrated face whose gaze points at the CTA/product (faces win attention fastest).
Add a second discovery after the hero (a detail reveal, micro-illustration, or a strong secondary block) so interest holds past 2 s.
